The refactoring is complete. Here's a summary of everything done:

### Refactoring: elements/ui independence from sketchpad

**Core changes in [elements.tsx](elements/ui/elements.tsx):**
- Defined `cn()`, `Expertise`, `setExpertiseProvider()`, `useLabel()` locally (no more sketchpad/i18n import)
- Defined `Point`, `Vector`, `Plane`, `Camera` interfaces locally (no more semio/js import)
- Moved `Canvas`, `HorizontalWindows`, `VerticalWindows` from sketchpad
- Added new **UI composite component** with:
  - `UIAppConfig` — app registration with windows, panel tabs, toolbar, footer
  - `UIWindowConfig` — window configuration with content and controls
  - `WindowKind`, `Theme`, `Mode` enums
  - `UIProps` — full app shell with multi-app management
  - `useUI()` hook for accessing active app state

**Dependency cleanup:**
- Replaced `@semio/sketchpad` with `tailwind-merge` in [package.json](elements/ui/package.json)
- Removed `@semio/sketchpad` and `@semio/js` path aliases from [tsconfig.json](elements/ui/tsconfig.json) and [.storybook/main.ts](elements/ui/.storybook/main.ts)

**Sketchpad updated to consume from elements:**
- [i18n.ts](semio/sketchpad/i18n.ts) re-exports `Expertise`, `setExpertiseProvider`, `useLabel` from elements
- [index.ts](semio/sketchpad/index.ts) re-exports `Canvas`, `HorizontalWindows`, `VerticalWindows` from elements
- [Sketchpad.tsx](semio/sketchpad/sketchpad/Sketchpad.tsx) imports layout primitives from elements

**10 new storybook stories:**
- **UI** — full app shell with multi-app switching, toolbar, panels
- **Window** — window states, horizontal/vertical/nested layouts
- **Page** — frontmatter, footer, long content
- **Panel** — side panels (left/right), bottom panel
- **Toolbar** — zones, groups, dividers, multi-zone
- **Strip/Band** — horizontal item strips
- **Card** — cards, grid, spinner, not found, loading row, section, aside
- **DiagramNode** — node states
- **Steps** — ordered step lists
- **PageNavigation** — prev/next navigation
